description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseOpenmrsMetadata' used as a superclass for metadata entities in the OpenMRS project. It includes properties like name, description, creator, dates, and retirement details, with annotations for persistence and indexing.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsMetadata
classes.description: An abstract class implementing common metadata properties for OpenMRS entities, including fields like name, description, creator, and retirement info, with Hibernate ORM annotations for persistence and Hibernate Search annotations for indexing.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' property of the metadata.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the 'name' property of the metadata.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the 'description' property.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the 'description' property.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created this metadata.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator user.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed this metadata (deprecated).

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last changed this metadata (deprecated).

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when this metadata was last changed (deprecated).

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when this metadata was last changed (deprecated).

methods.name: getRetired
methods.description: Returns whether the metadata is retired.

methods.name: setRetired
methods.description: Sets the retired status.

methods.name: getDateRetired
methods.description: Returns the date when the metadata was retired.

methods.name: setDateRetired
methods.description: Sets the retirement date.

methods.name: getRetiredBy
methods.description: Returns the user who retired this metadata.

methods.name: setRetiredBy
methods.description: Sets the user who retired this metadata.

methods.name: getRetireReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for retirement.

methods.name: setRetireReason
methods.description: Sets the retirement reason.
